non_blocking_findings.text: Headline 'Counted: a1, b2, b3' / '3 of 6 runs count' applies Q1 B + R1 gate only. D-147 Q2 OQ6 (Mark, 2026-11-12) says the loop re-runs 7m AC1 counting only runs whose docked control is valid. b2's control is 18.143 (invalid), so b2 does not count toward 7m AC1/AC12 under D-147. The doc says 'undecidable' in the prose, but the 'counts' label and 'R5 two counted runs met only with the repeat b3' could mislead. Suggested: 'b2 passes the post-reading and gate (counted under Q1 B) but, under D-147 Q2 OQ6, does not count toward 7m AC1 because its docked control is invalid; toward AC1 exactly one run (b3) counts.'

'b3 misses AC12 and 7m AC1' is one run. Add 'one valid-control counted run; AC12 needs the doc's two-run R5 condition, which is not met by two valid runs (b1 valid but evidence-only)'. The Verification-log row already scopes it correctly.

R2's stated prediction 'boosting-phase p99 <= 16.2' is never given a verdict. Re-derived boosting p99: a1 16.500, p4 16.029, b1 16.290, b2 16.201, b3 16.934, so 3 of 5 exceed 16.2 (b2 by 0.001). Add one sentence: 'the boosting prediction (<=16.2) held in p4 only, narrowly missed in b2, missed in a1, b1, b3.'

'35-58 % of slow frames' mixes two metrics (probe: sim-wait class; bench: sim wait over half the frame). Stated in the doc, but a reader could read it as one metric; I reproduced bench 11/31, 14/38, 23/50 and probe classes 19/33, 11/31.
'four sampler-clean runs' includes p4, which is evidence only (post NO on one GPU sample); stated elsewhere but the sentence should say '(three counted: a1, b2, b3; plus p4)'.
